changelog.body:
2-in-1 version
lsposed mode: choose the stores via scope
classic xposed mode: choose the stores via module's settings (old devices support)

lsposed mode:
select market apps you want in the scope to prevent updated inside it, no internal list of the markets now

New feature: block apps permissions revoke
App theme switch added

- Palm Store market added
- Apps list permission note added

add Xiaomi GetApp (Market) and Aurora Nightly

+ launcher icon version

readme:
# Update Locker

Block updates (and auto-updates) selected apps via popular markets

Block apps permissions revoke (system-wide)

## List of supported markets:
- Google Play Market
- Aurora Store
- Huawei AppGallery
- Samsung Galaxy Store
- Steam
- F-Droid
- App Lounge
- Aptoide
- RuMarket
- RuStore
- Mi GetApps
- Xiaomi Market
- Palm Store
- M Store (ex. Meizu App Store Global)
- any other defined via lsposed scope or the module settings

## Support/Discussion URL
[xda](https://forum.xda-developers.com/t/mod-xposed-4-1-updatelocker-stop-update-your-apps.4433253/) or [4pda](https://4pda.to/forum/index.php?s=&showtopic=603033&view=findpost&p=114402375)
